crossRefs.note: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution…
But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged…
Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more…
Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service…
